about: Geometry of the Sri Yantra solved from the concurrency conditions of Chiodo (2021) / Huet (1990, 2002). Coordinates are in units of the radius of the circle that circumscribes t3 and t7, centred on the origin, y upwards.

parameters.note: base points of t3, t6, t7, t9 as a fraction of the diameter OT, measured from the top of E

avaranas.name: trailokyamohana
avaranas.what: bhupura, three lines and four gates
